units.source_text: 右方的人驳道：“赫映姬升入月宫，此乃天上之事，下界无法探悉，故其结局如何，谁也不能知道。

en.t: The people on the right objected, saying, "Princess Kaguya ascended to the palace of the moon; that is a matter of heaven. People in the lower world cannot investigate it, so no one can know how her story ended.

units.source_text: 照她在这世间的缘分而论，投胎在竹筒之内，可知是身份低微之人。

en.t: Judging by her ties to this world, she was born inside a bamboo stalk, which shows that she was a person of lowly status.

units.source_text: 她的光辉虽然照耀了竹取老翁一家，但未能入宫为妃，以照耀九重宫阙。

en.t: Although her radiance shone upon the household of the old bamboo cutter, she was never able to enter the palace as a consort and illuminate the ninefold imperial halls.

units.source_text: 那安部多为欲娶她，不惜千金买了一件火鼠裘，

en.t: That Abe no Otari, wishing to marry her, spared no expense and bought a robe of fire-rat fur,

units.source_text: 但忽然烧掉了，真乃乏味之至。

en.t: but then it suddenly burned up, which was utterly disappointing.

units.source_text: 那车持皇子明知蓬莱山不可到达，假造一根玉枝来骗她，结果自己受辱，也可谓无聊之极了。”

en.t: And that Prince Kuramochi, knowing full well that Mount Horai could not be reached, forged a jeweled branch to deceive her, only to disgrace himself in the end; that too may be called the height of foolishness."

units.source_text: 这《竹取物语》画卷是名画家巨势相览所绘，由名诗人纪贯之题字。

en.t: This illustrated scroll of The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter was painted by the famous artist Kose no Soran, with the inscription written by the celebrated poet Ki no Tsurayuki.

units.source_text: 用的纸是纸屋纸，用中国薄绫镶边。

en.t: The paper used was kamiya paper, and it was bordered with thin Chinese twill silk.

units.source_text: 裱纸是紫红色的，轴是紫檀的。

en.t: The mounting paper was purplish red, and the roller was made of rosewood.
This was an ordinary style of mounting.
